findings.description: The rewrite only removes names found in `param.opts` and no longer removes names found in `param.secondary_opts`, which the original code also removed.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command defines a boolean flag with a secondary opt that collides with a help option name, e.g. `--flag/-h`, and `help_option_names` includes `-h`. Previously `-h` was dropped from the help option names. Now it is retained, so the help option and the flag both claim `-h`, giving a conflicting or shadowed option and changed behavior. The title says only that order is preserved, not that secondary opts are no longer reserved.
